# Jest Coverage Optimizer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > Jest

## Overview

Configures and optimizes Jest code coverage including thresholds, coverage reporters, and strategies for meaningful coverage metrics

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [jest-coverage-optimizer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
jest-coverage-optimizer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@jest-coverage-optimizer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure coverage collection with proper includes
- Set coverage thresholds for enforcement
- Analyze coverage reports for testing gaps
- Configure multiple coverage reporters

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Coverage Configuration**: Jest coverage collection settings
- **Thresholds**: Coverage enforcement in CI
- **Reporters**: Coverage report output formats
